name: Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti
japaneseName: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
description: Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti was the Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult representing Sloth and the primary antagonist of Arc 3. A manic spirit who inhabited various host bodies dubbed 'Fingers', he fanatically pursued the Witch of Envy's love. A century prior, he was known as the gentle spirit Geuse, a co-founder of the Witch Cult's moderate faction who protected Fortuna and young Emilia before being corrupted by the Sloth Witch Factor in Arc 4.
